# Sustainable IT Toolbox — full catalogue

Source: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/ — Institute for Sustainable IT (ISIT).
Generated on 2026-08-29. 341 resources.

## AI

### Adversarial robustness toolbox
Python library for machine learning security. ART provides tools that enable developers and researchers to defend and evaluate learning (ML) models and applications against adverse threats. ART supports all popular machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, MXNet, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, GPy, etc.), all data types (images, tables, audio, video , etc.) and machine learning of tasks (classification, object detection, voice recognition, generation, certification, etc.).
Website: https://github.com/Trusted-AI/adversarial-robustness-toolbox — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/adversarial-robustness-toolbox.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI, Machine Learning

### Aequitas Framework
Open source bias audit and fair machine learning toolkit for data scientists, ML researchers and policymakers.
Website: https://github.com/dssg/aequitas — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/aequitas-framework.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free

### Ai fairness 360 (aif360)
Open-source library of techniques for detecting and mitigating biases in machine learning models throughout the lifecycle of AI applications. The AI ​​Fairness 360 package is available in Python and R.
Website: https://github.com/Trusted-AI/AIF360 — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/ai-fairness-360-aif360.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI

### Anatomy of a cew
Anatomy of AI systems through interactive maps that can be used as a reference in the case of the measurement and or the LCA of an AI
Website: https://anatomyof.ai — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/anatomy-of-a-cew.html — Type: Infographic — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Keywords: Repository

### Artificial Intelligence Index Report (2023)
Annual report from Stanford University's Institute for Human-Centered AI, tracking the technical, economic and environmental trajectory of artificial intelligence.

### Carbontracker
Carbontracker is a tool for monitoring and predicting the energy consumption and carbon footprint of learning models (AI)
Website: https://github.com/saintslab/carbontracker — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/carbontracker.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI, Energy, Footprint

### Case studies on AI in Europe
Report on the environmental impacts of digital technology in Europe, with case studies covering AI, IoT and cloud services.
Website: https://www.greens-efa.eu/fr/article/document/digital-technologies-in-europe-9542 — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/case-studies-on-ai-in-europe.html — Type: Study

### claude-carbon
Open source extension displaying the carbon footprint of a Claude Code session directly in the terminal status line: cost, quota usage and grams of CO₂ emitted, updated continuously. Makes the impact of everyday AI use visible as it happens. MIT licence.
Website: https://github.com/gwittebolle/claude-carbon — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/claude-carbon.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI, Measurement, Carbon footprint, Open source

### EcoLogits
Open source Python library estimating the energy consumption and environmental footprint of calls to generative AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google, Hugging Face). Drops into existing code and surfaces the impact of every request, whether text, image or video. Maintained by GenAI Impact.
Website: https://ecologits.ai/latest/ — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/ecologits.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI, Measurement, Carbon footprint, Open source

### Green-ai
The Green AI Standard aims to develop a standard and raise awareness of best environmental practices in AI research and development
Website: https://github.com/daviddao/green-ai — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/green-ai.html — Type: Documentation — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Keywords: AI, Artificial Intelligence

### Impact'IA (SNCF)
Environmental footprint calculator for large language models, with a detailed methodology document. Covers thirty generative AI models from Google, Anthropic, OpenAI and Mistral, reporting greenhouse gas emissions, water and electricity use per token, with a life-cycle view and reduction practices. Built jointly by SNCF, Resilio and Wavestone.
Website: https://github.com/SNCFdevelopers/ImpactIA — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/impact-ia-sncf.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI, Measurement, Carbon footprint, Life-cycle assessment, Open source

### Interpretable machine learning

Website: https://christophm.github.io/interpretable-ml-book/ — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/interpretable-machine-learning.html — Type: Documentation — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Keywords: Repository

### Ml co2 impact

Website: https://mlco2.github.io/impact/ — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/ml-co2-impact.html — Type: Tool — Audience: Content creator / Intermediate — Access: Free — Keywords: HAVE

### Mlco2
This calculator will give you 2 figures: the gross carbon emissions produced and the approximate offset carbon emissions. The latter number depends on the grid used by the cloud provider and we are open to updating our estimates if anything seems inaccurate or out of date.
Website: https://mlco2.github.io/impact/#compute — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/mlco2.html — Keywords: Carbon Footprint, AI, Machine Learning

### Responsible AI course (Académie NR)
One-hour course on the ethical, environmental and governance stakes of artificial intelligence, from the INR's training academy.
Website: https://www.academie-nr.org/mooc-ia/fr/index.html — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/responsible-ai-course-academie-nr.html — Type: MOOC — Audience: General public / Beginner — Access: Free — Keywords: Training, AI, INR

### Tfjs-models
This repository hosts a set of pre-trained models that have been ported to TensorFlow.js. The templates are hosted on NPM and unpkg so they can be used in any out-of-the-box project. They can be used directly or in a transfer learning setting with TensorFlow.js.
Website: https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/tfjs-models.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: AI

### The turing way
he Turing Way is a reproducible, ethical and collaborative Data Science manual. We involve and support a diverse community of contributors to make data science accessible, understandable and effective for all. Our aim is to provide all the information that researchers and data scientists in academia, industry and the public sector need at the start of their projects to ensure that they are easy to replicate later.
Website: https://github.com/the-turing-way/the-turing-way — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/the-turing-way.html — Type: Documentation — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Keywords: Data, Data Science, HandBook, Manual, Open Data

### Accessible office documents (rgaa)
Create accessible office documents: The RGAA applies to any document or application available online: Internet, Intranet and web applications, but also content available for download. In the RGAA consultation theme, criterion 13.7 (level A) stipulates that "each office document for download has, if necessary, an accessible version". Compliance with this criterion can be achieved in particular by providing an accessible HTML version or by making the document accessible in the format offered for download.
Website: https://github.com/DISIC/guides-documents_bureautiques_accessibles — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/accessible-office-documents-rgaa.html — Audience: Content creator / Intermediate — Access: Free — Keywords: Accessibility Microsoft Word, Adobe Acrobat Pro Document Cloud, Calc, Excel, Impress, LibreOffice Writer, PowerPoint, RGAA

### Accessible-DfA font

### Contrastradio
Used to test the contrast ratio between two colors. The tool provides guidance on the level of compliance that can potentially be achieved with this color scheme. To achieve AA accessibility level: minimum contrast ratio of 4.5: 1. For AAA level: minimum contrast ratio of 7: 1.
Website: https://www.siegemedia.com/contrast-ratio — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/contrastradio.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Accessibility

### Pix
Digital skills assessment and certification platform for all. Digital is now everywhere. In our professional and private life. Mastering the Internet and computers has become a major issue for society. In this context, Pix's mission is to help everyone to cultivate their digital skills. Pix is ​​aimed at everyone: pupils, students, working professionals, dropouts, job seekers, seniors, or more simply citizens who wish to measure, develop and enhance their digital skills. The service takes the form of an online platform for the assessment and certification of digital skills. Pix seeks to arouse the desire for lifelong learning by offering a standard as well as innovative, demanding and benevolent assessment methods.
Website: https://github.com/1024pix/pix — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/pix.html — Type: Organisation — Audience: General public / Beginner — Access: Free — Keywords: Digital Mediation, Digital Skills, Illectronism, Inclusion

### Apply the principles of green it
It is common to hear that digital technology is “green”, that is to say that it has little or no ecological impact, or even that it reduces the ecological impacts of the rest of our economy. . In this MOOC, these two ideas will be questioned. Indeed, digital technology has on the contrary real and growing ecological impacts: greenhouse gas emissions, pollution, production of toxic waste, etc. In addition, its ability to reduce the ecological impacts of the rest of our economy is questionable (rebound effect, planned obsolescence, etc.).
Website: https://openclassrooms.com/fr/courses/6227476-appliquez-les-principes-du-green-it-dans-votre-entreprise — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/apply-the-principles-of-green-it.html — Type: Documentation — Audience: General public / Beginner — Keywords: MOOC, Training

### Lowtus
This tool / this site offers site rankings according to criteria of performance, SEO, security and good practices. Lowtus does not try to say which site is better than another; who has a good site and who has a bad site. Lowtus tests web pages, but does not present fine indicators that would allow a one-off quality improvement process to be initiated. Lowtus does not have a business model or profitability objective. Its objective is above all to present a different approach to control the quality of web pages. Lowtus is not versed in free, not necessarily out of discretion, but because the code remains very specific for the moment. We need to sit down the architecture to see how to eventually free some bricks from it.
Website: https://lowtus.fr/ — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/lowtus.html — Type: Tool — Audience: Content creator / Intermediate — Access: Free — Keywords: SEO

### Responsible management

### Software management plans
Checklist for a software management plan. This checklist will help you write an SMP. It consists of sections that cover the key elements that an SMP should include. A software management plan (SMP) can help you define a set of structures and goals for understanding your research software, including what you will develop; who is the software for (even if it's just for you); how you will deliver your software to the users it is intended for; how it will help them; and how you will assess whether it has helped them and contributed to the research, as you intended. An SMP also helps you understand how you can support those who want or use your research software; how your software relates to other artifacts in your research ecosystem; and how you will ensure that your software remains available beyond the lifespan of your current project.
Website: https://zenodo.org/records/2159713 — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/software-management-plans.html — Type: Documentation — Audience: General public / Beginner — Access: Free — Keywords: Management plan, Software management plan

Sets aside the folklore and gives the actual carbon footprint of an email, with three ways to reduce it — and why emptying your inbox achieves almost nothing.
Website: https://www.sami.eco/blog/empreinte-carbone-email — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/the-carbon-footprint-of-an-email-myths-and-reality.html — Type: Article

## Energy & resource management

### Carbon Aware SDK (Green Software Foundation)
Development kit that lets an application shift its workloads to the times or regions where electricity is least carbon-intensive. Moves from measurement to action without changing the architecture.
Website: https://github.com/Green-Software-Foundation/carbon-aware-sdk — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/carbon-aware-sdk-green-software-foundation.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Energy, Cloud, Open source

### Cpu energy meter
CPU Energy Meter is a Linux tool that allows you to monitor the energy consumption of Intel processors with fine temporal granularities (a few tens of milliseconds). Power monitoring is available for the following power domains:
- by package domain (CPU socket)
- by core domain (all processor cores in a package)
- by uncore domain (uncore components, by example, integrated graphics on client processors)
- by memory node (local memory of a package, server processors only)
- by platform (all devices on the platform that are powered by an integrated power mechanism , for example, processor cores, SOC, memory, add-ons or peripherals)
Website: https://github.com/sosy-lab/cpu-energy-meter — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/cpu-energy-meter.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Energy

### Electricitymap
Allows you to view the quantity of CO₂ emitted to produce your electricity, in real time.
The regions of the world are colored according to the carbon intensity (including all greenhouse gases) of the electricity consumed there.
Website: https://app.electricitymaps.com/map/live/fifteen_minutes — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/electricitymap.html — Type: Tool — Audience: General public / Beginner — Access: Free — Keywords: CO2, EU, Electricity, Energy, Europe, Reference data

### Energybox
EnergyBox is a parameterized tool that allows precise studies of communication energy in the user, using real traffic traces as input. Currently, it focuses on the most popular wireless technologies (3G and WiFi) and emulates the communication energy footprint of application data at the user device level. EnergyBox performs iterative simulation based on the trace.
Website: https://github.com/rtslab/EnergyBox — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/energybox.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Energy, Mobile, Networks

### Cloud carbon footprint

Python script that estimates the carbon footprint of all Cloud Foundry (CF) applications in an organization. The script uses basic "cf cli" commands to count the number of running containers per space. This is then multiplied by an estimated average energy consumption

### Powerapi
PowerAPI is a middleware toolkit for creating software-defined power meters. Software-defined power meters are configurable software libraries that can estimate software power consumption in real time. PowerAPI supports the acquisition of raw metrics from a wide variety of sensors (e.g. physical meters, processor interfaces, hardware counters, OS counters) and the provision of power consumption through different channels (including file system, network, web, graphics). As a middleware toolkit, PowerAPI offers the ability to assemble “à la carte” power meters to meet user needs.
Website: https://github.com/powerapi-ng/powerapi — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/powerapi.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Energy

### PowerJoular
Measures the power consumption of hardware components and software on GNU/Linux. Reports CPU and GPU energy for servers and PCs, and ARM CPU energy on supported boards.
Website: https://gitlab.com/joular/powerjoular — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/powerjoular.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Energy, Linux, Measurement

### Powersim
Power / energy simulation in SystemC (not to be confused with VHDL). Powersim is a SystemC class library for calculating the power and energy consumption of hardware described at the system level. To this end, C ++ operators are monitored and different energy models can be used for each type of data.
Website: http://powersim.sourceforge.net — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/powersim.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: C ++, Energy, Power, Simulation

### Powertop
PowerTOP is a Linux tool used to diagnose power consumption and power management issues. In addition to being a diagnostic tool, PowerTOP also has an interactive mode that you can use to experiment with various power management settings, in cases where the Linux distribution has not enabled these settings.
Website: https://github.com/fenrus75/powertop — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/powertop.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Access: Free — Keywords: Energy

### Éco2mix
éCO2mix is ​​a tool created by RTE to help consumers learn more about and consume electricity better. éCO2mix provides all the indicators of electricity consumption and production in real time, 24 hours a day, at national and regional level: Electricity consumption in mainland France (excluding Corsica) as well as our forecasts calculated on the old and at the beginning of the afternoon on D-day, French electricity production by sector in value and percentage, Trade in electricity with our 6 neighboring countries, CO2 emissions generated by electricity production, Monthly data at the 'regional scale: consumption, production and interregional flows.

### Rtlamr
Utilities often use "smart meters" to optimize their residential meter reading infrastructure. Smart meters transmit consumption information in different ISM bands, which allows utilities to simply send readers through neighborhoods to collect product consumption information. One protocol in particular: Encoder Receiver Transmitter by Itron is fairly straightforward to decode and operates in the 900 MHz ISM band, well within the adjustable range of inexpensive rtl-sdr dongles. This project is a software-defined radio receiver for these messages. We use an inexpensive rtl-sdr dongle to enable users to non-invasively record and analyze their household product consumption.
Website: https://github.com/bemasher/rtlamr — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/rtlamr.html — Keywords: IoT, Meter, SmartBuilding, SmartCitie, SmartMeter

### TCO Certified
Global sustainability certification for IT products, addressing climate, hazardous substances, circularity and supply chain responsibility.
Website: https://tcocertified.com/ — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/tco-certified.html — Type: Tool

### TV Size to Distance Calculator
Works out the right ratio between screen size, resolution and viewing distance, so a larger or higher-definition screen is not bought needlessly.
Website: https://www.rtings.com/tv/reviews/by-size/size-to-distance-relationship — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/tv-size-to-distance-calculator.html — Type: Infographic

### Coldcms
A CMS built for ecological performance. ColdCMS is a Django project based on Wagtail CMS and Bulma CSS Framework. Admin can edit websites through intuitive and user-friendly interface. Different types of pages are pre-designed, which allows you to have a beautiful website without spending hours on it. ColdCMS is specially designed for people who want to reduce the impact of their use of digital technologies on the environment. The client's website consists of static pages, built with the Wagtail Bakery. The pages of the site are generated and updated as necessary (for example when the administrator publishes or modifies content). Among other optimizations, CSS file sizes are reduced and unused CSS code is removed, using PurgeCSS and clean-css. ColdCMS supports Python> = 3.6.
Website: https://gitlab.com/hashbangfr/coldcms — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/coldcms.html — Type: Tool — Audience: IT professional / Expert — Keywords: CMS, Framework, Lowtech

### Energy usage

### Good practices in eco-design
This brochure is a complement to the 3 brochures of good practices related to software development offered by the network of SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT players within Higher Education and Research: DevLOG. This section is dedicated to good practices in terms of digital service ecodesign which make it possible to apprehend, understand and reduce the environmental footprint of digital technology. After having explained the general context in a first sheet, a second sheet ("But why?") Highlights the need to integrate an environmental dimension in our digital service designs, and consequently in our software developments. The third sheet ("When?") Recalls the stages in the life cycle of a digital service to introduce the best practice sheets that correspond to the different stages: "Before", "During" and "After", keeping in mind the mind that development is often iterative, and the boundaries between the different stages are permeable. At the end of the brochure, you will find a specific sheet on good ecodesign practices for scientific computing, as well as sheets on development on a mobile platform, for the web and on the accelerator.
Website: https://hal.archives-ouvertes.fr/hal-03009741/ — Entry: https://sustainableit-tools.isit-europe.org/en/tools/good-practices-in-eco-design.html — Type: Study — Audience: General public / Beginner — Keywords: Ecodesign, Referential

### Susty
Susty is a super lightweight WordPress theme called Susty. It was designed to show how small a WordPress site can be (only 6KB of data transfer, or 7 with Yoast!). Experimenting with minimalism, the goal of this theme is to provide just enough code to power the site. 'Susty WP interface. So it is not recommended to go ahead and activate for your blog or production website without making some adjustments first. The objectives of this theme are described in a blog post titled Delivering WordPress in 7KB.
